title: Surreal Studio Doorway
description: A man in a blue cap and green shirt stands in an open doorway, looking at a large surreal painting of a steampunk submarine with a giant green eye sailing through stormy waters. The artist's studio contains a black leather office chair, wooden desk, dark wooden chair, and walls covered in floating letters, gears, and mechanical elements.
prompt: A man wearing a blue cap stands with his back to us in the doorway of a colorful art studio, gazing at a large surreal painting on the wall depicting a massive ornate steampunk submarine with a giant green human eye as its central feature, sailing through turbulent blue waves under a stormy sky with distant factories. The studio has wooden floors, a black leather office chair, scattered mechanical parts, floating alphabet letters and copper gears on green and copper walls, warm light spilling through the open door.
